facts.F18: Claim-to-checker: namespace placement, Domain reach and handler order are finite facts read from the compiled IL and the composition root, checked by the two ArchUnit oracles (Finite laws) and by EXAMINE probes (architecture-rules, backend-tests, ef-model-unchanged, deliveries-answers-compare, deliveries-answers-selftest, refresh-reactions-show, test-selection-show, ci-live-suites-show). No Quint, TLA+ or Agda model: nothing is a state machine, queue or proof obligation (no handler, schedule or queue moves) and a model would restate the namespace map. Liveness not applicable: no progress property exists. Type strength: native C# namespaces, no new types; invalid placement is excluded by the IL rules, not by construction.
